title: 12 Best Sushi Restaurants in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's top 12 sushi restaurants for 2026, from Michelin-starred omakase to bustling market eateries. Find authentic Edo-mae, budget-friendly picks, and unique experiences.

places.name: Sushi Saito
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase course, featuring seasonally perfect nigiri like chu-toro, uni, and anago.

places.name: Sushi Sawada
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full Omakase, especially his signature toro and gizzard shad (kohada).

places.name: Sushi Arai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal Omakase, focusing on his exquisite preparation of tuna cuts and shellfish.

places.name: Sushi Sho
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full Omakase experience, allowing Chef Nakazawa to guide you through his diverse preparations and aged fish.

places.name: Sushi Kanesaka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase course, particularly their classic tuna and sea urchin nigiri.

places.name: Sushi Dai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase set (Jyu-ni Nigiri Set) which gives you a great variety, and then order any additional pieces that catch your eye.

places.name: Sushi no Midori (Ginza Branch)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Toku-sen Nigiri Set' (Special Selection Nigiri) for a broad taste of their best offerings.

places.name: Uogashi Nihon-ichi Standing Sushi Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a few pieces of your favorites, like salmon, maguro, and ebi, and experiment with seasonal specials.

places.name: Nemuro Hanamaru (KITTE Marunouchi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab plates off the belt or order specific items from the touch screen, especially anything with Hokkaido scallops or salmon.

places.name: Tachigui Sushi Bar Uochan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for the daily specials (kyō no osusume) written on the board, often featuring unique seasonal catches.

places.name: Midori Sohonten (Ueno Branch)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Kaisendon' (seafood rice bowl) for a hearty meal, or any of their large nigiri sets.

places.name: Kaikaya by the Sea
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous tuna bone with garlic steak, followed by the sashimi platter or creative sushi rolls.
